academic_back_subject_schedule_valid.name: academic_back_subject_schedule_valid
academic_back_subject_schedule_valid.value: "academic_back_subjects"."status" <> 'scheduled' OR ("academic_back_subjects"."scheduled_school_year" IS NOT NULL AND "academic_back_subjects"."scheduled_period" IS NOT NULL)

academic_back_subject_clearance_valid.name: academic_back_subject_clearance_valid
academic_back_subject_clearance_valid.value: "academic_back_subjects"."status" <> 'cleared' OR ("academic_back_subjects"."cleared_grade" IS NOT NULL AND "academic_back_subjects"."cleared_grade" BETWEEN 75 AND 100)

class_record_score_status_valid.name: class_record_score_status_valid
class_record_score_status_valid.value: ("class_record_scores"."status" = 'recorded' AND "class_record_scores"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "class_record_scores"."score" >= 0) OR ("class_record_scores"."status" = 'excused' AND "class_record_scores"."score" IS NULL AND length(trim("class_record_scores"."reason")) > 0 AND "class_record_scores"."reason" IS NOT NULL)
